note: The T015 stage-1 kill decision. Kept beside the measurements rather than inside them so re-running the capture cannot silently rewrite a verdict, and so the verdict names the exact bytes it was formed from.

frameTime.statement: No measurable frame-time cost. Both variants render every measured frame inside the display interval at all three stations, so the median is pinned at the refresh period and carries no information; the tail is what varies and it does not separate the variants.

heap.statement: Each capture runs in a fresh page target and reads its heap after a forced collection, so the delta is texture residency rather than accumulation. A first attempt reused one tab and reported roughly 35 MB; that figure was an artefact of about 10 MB of per-navigation accumulation and is not the cost.

visual.statement: Inspected still by still against the untextured baseline at identical cameras. At facade and street range the textured variant is strictly more legible: courses, reveals and openings read as construction rather than as flat panels. At far-silhouette range, past the LOD 0 cut-off and at maximum tile repeats per screen pixel, the facades stay even — no speckle, no horizontal clumping and no moire, which is the failure T028 measured under unspecified sampler filtering and which LINEAR/LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR is carried here to prevent. No artefact was found that the untextured baseline does not also have.
visual.knownDifferenceNotADefect: Roof and ground surfaces read darker in the textured variant. They carry no tile; the change is the committed V3T calibrated palette, which divides each designed colour through its motif mean so a textured wall keeps its intended tone. It is a designed consequence of the profile, not an artefact of texturing.

consequence: The wave proceeds TEXTURED: the renderable subset ships procedural-texture-v1 tiles on LOD 0 under the procedural-replay admission. Had any measure failed, the same pipeline would have shipped the identical geometry with LOWER_MANHATTAN_CENSUS_PROFILE and no other change.
